targets.recommended_evidence_direction_note: OVERTURN the self-stamped weakens -> non_contributory. Two independent reasons: (1) MEASUREMENT FLOOR -- the outcome DVs (harm_discrimination ~0.022 with cross-seed sign flips; slot_differentiation 0.056-0.87 variance) are at the noise floor in the HEALTHY ARM_A, so no additive dual-pathway degradation could be detected regardless of the claim's truth; the manipulation checks (C5) passing only confirms the arms were applied, not that the readout can discriminate. (2) DOMAIN MISMATCH -- MECH-175 is a clinical dementia-risk / additivity claim whose decisive test is mediation analysis on a clinical cohort; a CausalGridWorld memory-consolidation proxy is not a fair test of it. A weakens here would falsify the wrong layer.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-698 (2026-06-21, failure-autopsy): reclassified weakens -> non_contributory for MECH-175. The 4-arm grid-world dual-pathway test applied its manipulations correctly (C5 PASS: REM rollouts 30->0, encoder magnitude 1.0->0.3) but the outcome DVs are at the noise floor even in the healthy arm (harm_discrimination_mean 0.022 with per-seed sign flips; slot_differentiation 0.056-0.87 cross-seed variance), so the predicted additive degradation (C1-C4) could not be detected regardless of the claim. Moreover MECH-175 is a clinical pharmacology/epidemiology claim whose decisive test is mediation analysis on an anticholinergic-burden cohort (per its own notes) -- out-of-domain for CausalGridWorld. The FAIL does not weaken the claim. Recommend reclassifying MECH-175 epistemic_category: out_of_domain (research_anchor handling); no REE experiment should weight it.
